name: kimai
description: Kimai timers in Claude Code: a footer chip for running timers and a /kimai panel to list, edit and start them

url.title: Kimai URL
url.description: Base URL of your Kimai server, e.g. https://kimai.example.com

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.description: A Kimai API token. Leave empty to use the headers helper instead.

headersHelper.title: Headers helper
headersHelper.description: Shell command that prints a token, or a JSON object of HTTP headers. Example: op read "op://Vault/Kimai/credential"

helperTtlMinutes.title: Helper cache (minutes)
helperTtlMinutes.description: How long to reuse the headers helper's output before running it again. 0 runs it for every request.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the footer chip checks Kimai for running timers (at least 15)
